name: Baseline
drill_format: Binary calls, results shown at the end of each day
gate_rule: Finish 60 binary calls over three sessions
gate_evidence: No pass or fail: this is the measurement

name: Calibration
gate_rule: 200 fresh calls: average confidence within 5 points of hit rate, and no band more than 2.5 standard errors off
gate_evidence: Sim D: a calibrated player passes 88%, a typical overconfident one 1%, an underconfident one 5%

name: Sharp questions
skill: Write predictions a stranger could score
drill_format: Rewrite a vague prediction, graded by the coach
gate_rule: 10 journal predictions in a row accepted without edits

name: Ranges
skill: Give 90% ranges that hold 9 times in 10
gate_rule: 60 fresh ranges: 50 to 58 contain the truth
gate_evidence: Sim G: a calibrated player passes 95%, a 70%-coverage player 1%, an always-wide player 12%

name: Fermi
skill: Break an unknown into parts you can estimate
drill_format: Fermi problems, plus probability chains in the lesson slot
gate_rule: 20 fresh Fermi problems: truth inside your range on 16 or more, and median miss within a factor of 3
gate_evidence: Binomial: true 90% coverage passes 96%, 70% coverage passes 24%. OPEN: the factor-3 rule needs playtest data

name: Outside view
skill: Start from how often this kind of thing happens
new_move: Outside-view link graded against the checker's reference class
gate_rule: 40 fresh base-rate problems: 32 or more within 7 points
journal_requirement: 15 journal cards carry an accepted base rate

name: Updating
skill: Move in measured steps when evidence arrives
new_move: Update action with a logged reason; time-weighted points
drill_format: Evidence streams: prior, news, new number
gate_rule: 40 fresh update problems: 32 or more within 7 points, and your updates must not lower your time-weighted score
gate_evidence: Binomial: 85% skill passes 87%, 70% skill passes 11%. OPEN: the update-value rule needs real data
journal_requirement: 12 open predictions updated with a reason

name: Second opinions
skill: Argue against yourself before reality does
new_move: Case against graded by Predict, and a second estimate
gate_rule: 28 fresh strongest-counter-argument items: 22 or more right
gate_evidence: Binomial: 85% skill passes 89%, 70% skill passes 22%. OPEN: an outcome gate (averaged estimate beats the first) needs data
journal_requirement: 14 journal cards carry a case against graded sound

name: Autopsy
skill: Separate bad luck from bad judgment
new_move: Autopsy on every resolved case; memory check before each reveal
gate_rule: 30 fresh luck-or-judgment cases: 24 or more right, and memory drift within 5 points over 30 checks

name: Decisions
skill: Turn a forecast into a choice
new_move: Decision card: forecast, threshold, review date
gate_rule: 30 fresh decision problems: 24 or more right
journal_requirement: 10 real decisions logged with a forecast and reviewed

name: Fine grain
skill: Use the whole scale including the tails
new_move: 1% dial; sharp mode (log rule); multi-outcome questions
drill_format: Tail-heavy binary calls under the sharp rule
gate_rule: 400 fresh calls: average confidence within 3 points of hit rate
gate_evidence: Sim D: a calibrated player passes 86%, a mildly overconfident one 18%, a typical overconfident one 0.1%

name: With the machine
skill: Combine your forecast with an AI forecast
new_move: Second-forecaster reveal, then a final answer
drill_format: World questions: commit, see Predict's forecast, finalise
gate_rule: Over 60 resolved world questions, your final forecasts score at least as well as your first forecasts and as Predict's alone
gate_evidence: OPEN: needs about 8 weeks of real data
journal_requirement: 60 resolved world questions carrying both forecasts

name: Arena
drill_format: Live questions on Good Judgment Open and Metaculus
gate_rule: 50 resolved public questions with a better-than-crowd score
